mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.filename, f.original_filename, f.path, f.file_size, f.file_type, f.sha256_hash, f.file_suffix, f.user_id, f.parent_id, f.isFolder, f.isDeleted, f.local_file_path, f.created_at, f.updated_at, f.deleted_at, f.isStarred, f.starred_at, f.category_id FROM t_recent_access r INNER JOIN t_file_info f ON r.file_id = f.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND f.isDeleted = 0 ORDER BY r.accessed_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
